caption: Piazza IV Novembre, Perugia
composition: Fontana Maggiore with Palazzo dei Priori · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The view stands in the middle of the empty piazza with the Fontana Maggiore in the center foreground, its carved polygonal basins stacked on wide stone steps. To the left the crenellated stone façade of the Palazzo dei Priori glows in the early sun, and to the right the cathedral front rises with its external staircase and rose window. Rooftops and a slender bell tower close the view in the middle distance. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 07:25 Europe/Rome: clear morning light raking across the stone.
